t: Mapei Mapesil AC 131 is a premium solvent-free silicone sealant designed for effective sealing of walls and floors around baths and showers. This high-performance sealant offers a mould-resistant and high-quality surface finish, suitable for both interior and exterior applications, including underwater use. It securely bonds to ceramic, porcelain, glass, and plastic, making it ideal for various professional sealing tasks. The highly elastic formulation accommodates expansion joints in tiling, ensuring long-lasting seals in demanding environments such as swimming pools, bathrooms, and kitchens. A matching grout is also available.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
